title: Rayaru Bandaru Mavana Manege
desc: Suma and Vishnu act as a married couple to please her father. However, they get into trouble when her father finds out the truth.

title: Golisoda
desc: Four orphans living in the City Market in Bengaluru decide to make a name for themselves by opening a restaurant. However, things get out of control when some goons decide to wreak havoc.

title: Victory
desc: The daughter of a farmer is determined to become an international cricketer despite facing numerous challenges to make her father feel content.

title: Mr. Theertha

title: Nigooda Atma
desc: When an evil spirit begins to terrorise a family, it initiates a horrifying chain of events that exposes dark secrets long hidden by the past.
